Extract this entire folder. Double-click droneid_ui.exe.
Use IQ replay, Live X310, or Automatic sweep in Source settings.
Click a decoded packet for its details and map location. Map defaults to Punjab; uncached tiles need internet. Read PACKET_MAP.md.
Live modes require a compatible 64-bit UHD runtime. No UHD DLL is bundled.
Read WINDOWS.md, AUTOMATIC_SWEEP.md and FINAL_VERIFICATION.md. Full model/channel coverage acceptance is pending.
O4 results are candidates, not confirmed identities. O4+ and physical DF are not complete.
Replay-example.cmd uses a small licensed reference excerpt. Sweep-plan.cmd does not access the radio.
Keep the matching punjdrone-windows-source.zip and licenses if redistributing.
